title: Message/query pagination off-by-one: list_by_chat(limit+position) then skip(position)
description: SEC1 finding: message.rs Message/query handler calls list_by_chat(limit+position) then applies .skip(position). If list_by_chat treats the argument as an absolute LIMIT (not a window size), the result at position>0 is wrong: requesting limit+position rows, skipping position, returns only limit rows correctly, BUT only if the table has >=limit+position rows. The contract of list_by_chat must be confirmed and tests added for position>0 with non-zero offset to verify actual pagination behavior is correct.
